rolePicker.technicianPerks: No fees · Salons contact you directly
rolePicker.foundingNote: Accounts created before Jan 1, 2027 get the Founding member badge on their profile. It isn't issued after that date.
rolePicker.ownerPerks: No fees · Message and call techs in the app
rolePicker.how1Desc: Pick how you'll use PawNail and your area — it takes about a minute.
rolePicker.how2Desc: Browse looks, salons, techs and jobs near you.
rolePicker.how3Desc: Contact salons and techs directly in the app.
rolePicker.faq1A: No. PawNail doesn't charge techs or salons. Signing up, posting jobs, browsing portfolios and messaging cost nothing.
rolePicker.faq2Q: Is my phone number kept private?
rolePicker.faq2A: A tech's phone number is shown to a salon owner only after they unlock the contact. Phone numbers on job posts are published by the salon on purpose.
rolePicker.faq3Q: Can I use it in Australia?
rolePicker.faq3A: Yes. PawNail supports both the US and Australia — choose your market when you sign up.
rolePicker.faq4Q: How do I delete my account?
rolePicker.faq4A: Go to Account → Delete account. Your profile and the messages you sent are permanently removed.
